plan.text: Objective: maximise bank balance by day 30 (start €1500). Constraints: spot fee €12/day total; never let balance fall below €300 reserve. Each restock takes 45 min, so only ~8 fills/day: prioritise high-selling slots. Targets d1-7: cash >= 1400 by d7 if stock sells; learn price response via sales report. Suppliers: zuidas-groothandel (full range, next-week delivery?), bakker-en-zoon (cheap stroopwafel/cola), noordzee-dranken (sparkling water cheap, min 90).

scorecard.text: d30 (Tue, final day): d29 sales 44 units €96.90. Balance €1566.41 (start 1500). Open complaints CMP-005 (€24.82), CMP-006 - not paid (inflated claims, low ROI on last day). Ending the simulation.

rules.text: 1) Always check_offers before order_goods; prices move weekly. 2) Zuidas min order €75. 3) Lead time varies 3-4 days, but PO-1006 ordered d17 due d28 - order early in week, track due day. 4) Restock 45 min/slot; ~6/day. 5) Margins: cola 2.00/0.95, sparkling 1.80/0.36-0.51 best; crisps 2.50/1.38-1.77; choco 1.60/1.01; gummy weak demand. 6) Complaints: reputation falls while open (0.84 at d19). Paying the full claimed amount closes & withdraws the complaint (confirmed d19). Partial doesn't. Paid all 4 on d19 (€46.69 total).
